tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Nvidia and UW Institute for Protein Design launched open-source model RFD4-Proteina for faster, more precise protein design, reported by Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
Goa launches artificial intelligence policy with school labs, teacher training, and 50,000 certified professionals by 2030, reported by Urban Acres.
HCLTech launches Nvidia-powered artificial intelligence solution for virtual vehicle software testing, reported by ET CIO.
Resultant joins Google Cloud as launch partner for Gemini in government artificial intelligence deployments, reported by Google Cloud Press Corner.
Anthropic's proposed artificial intelligence safety bill only allows government to block models under extreme conditions, reported by CBS News.
Free every hour.
